## Plans

Northwind Cloud offers three plans: Starter, Team, and Enterprise. Starter costs $12 per user per month and includes 50 GB of storage per workspace. Team costs $29 per user per month and includes 1 TB of storage per workspace. Enterprise pricing is negotiated annually and has a minimum commitment of 100 seats.

## Free trial

Every new workspace gets a 14-day free trial of the Team plan. No credit card is required to start a trial. When the trial ends, the workspace is downgraded to read-only mode until a plan is selected.

## Uptime commitment

Northwind Cloud commits to 99.9% monthly uptime for Team plans and 99.99% monthly uptime for Enterprise plans. Starter plans have no uptime commitment.

Scheduled maintenance windows are announced at least 72 hours in advance on the status page and do not count as downtime. Maintenance normally occurs on Sundays between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC.

## Authentication

Single sign-on (SSO) via SAML 2.0 is available on Team and Enterprise plans. SCIM user provisioning is available on Enterprise only. Two-factor authentication can be enforced for all members by any workspace admin.

## Billing

Monthly plans are billed on the first day of each calendar month. Annual plans receive a 20% discount compared with monthly billing. Invoices are emailed to the billing contact and can also be downloaded from the Billing page in the admin console.

Northwind accepts Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. Enterprise customers may also pay by bank transfer with net-30 terms. PayPal is not accepted.

## Channels

Starter customers can get help through the community forum and email support. Team customers additionally get live chat. Enterprise customers get a dedicated customer success manager and a private Slack channel.

## Refunds

Monthly plans are non-refundable, but cancelling stops all future charges. Annual plans can be refunded on a prorated basis if cancelled within the first 60 days of the term. After 60 days, annual plans are not refundable.
